title: Raas Garba Festival 2026 Fri, Oct 9th - 7:30 Pm
description: Immerse in the Vibrant Colors of BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026
long_description:
Immerse in the Vibrant Colors of BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026
Mark your calendars for the 9th of October, 2026 as the Bay Area Youth Vaishnav Parivar (shahsaumilb) proudly presents the BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival. As the sun sets at 7.30 PM, immerse yourself in the vibrant colors and exuberant energy of this Gujarati Navratri/Dandiya event. This festival will not only showcase a mesmerizing spectacle of traditional dance and music but also highlight the richness of Gujarati culture and the spirit of Navratri.
Meet the Maestro of Melody
While we are yet to announce the artist for the evening, you can rest assured knowing that we always bring performers who are masters in their craft. Our artists are known for their captivating performances that leave the audience spellbound, helping them connect with the joyous spirit of Navratri. Stay tuned for the grand reveal!
Experience the Grandeur at Shreemaya Krishnadham Haveli
The festival will be held at the grand Shreemaya Krishnadham Haveli, located at 175 Nortech Parkway, San Jose, CA, United States. This venue is famous for its serene and divine ambiance, perfectly suited for a religious and cultural event like ours. The Haveli is easily accessible, ensuring a hassle-free commute for everyone. There is ample parking available and for those seeking a complete Indian experience, plenty of Indian restaurants are located nearby.
Ease Your Entry with Our Ticketing Information
We have a variety of tickets available for the event to cater to all age groups. Adult tickets are priced at $25.00, while tickets for children aged 5 to 12 years and senior citizens aged 70 years and above are available at a discounted price of $20.00. Secure your spot today and get ready to experience a night filled with music, dance, and cultural richness!
